target.title: refactor: consolidate safe JSON parsing
target.body:
Closes #99665

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a maintainability problem where tolerant JSON string parsing was reimplemented across core callers, making it difficult to distinguish parsing mechanics from filesystem, logging, schema, fallback, JSONL, unsafe-integer, and error-reporting policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a dependency-free `@openclaw/normalization-core/json-coercion` owner that returns parsed values and `undefined` for syntax failures. Migrated callers retain their existing record coercion, trimming, classification, and fallback decisions; differently contracted public SDK, schema, filesystem, streaming, JSONL, and error-surfacing paths remain unchanged.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Maintainers get one tested primitive for tolerant JSON parsing, smaller caller implementations, and aligned build/test/UI resolver plumbing for the new package subpath.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/ui/control-ui-vite-config.node.test.ts packages/normalization-core/src/json-coercion.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-message-tool-source-reply.test.ts src/acp/runtime/session-meta.test.ts src/agents/subagent-yield-output.test.ts src/chat/canvas-render.test.ts src/logging/diagnostic-support-log-redaction.test.ts test/scripts/prepare-extension-package-boundary-artifacts.test.ts` — 58 tests passed across six Vitest projects on final rebased commit.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox: provider `blacksmith-testbox`, id `tbx_01kwn2x34zh7e37qs62zsw8f4s`, Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28686718227 — all changed checks, typechecks, lint, import-cycle checks, package build, and Control UI build passed.
- Autoreview: `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --prompt-file /tmp/safe-json-autoreview.md --stream-engine-output` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings after the final UI alias fix.
- Search proof: `rg -n 'JSON\.parse' src/acp/runtime/session-meta.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-message-tool-source-reply.ts src/agents/subagent-yield-output.ts src/chat/canvas-render.ts src/logging/diagnostic-support-log-redaction.ts` returns no matches.
- Production LOC: 50 added, 52 deleted, net -2.
